pages.wave1_intro: Dahlia leads you deeper into the Mistwood, her petals glowing faintly as the mist thickens around you.
pages.wave1_intro_ability_rules:
Backup (Boss): When this boss is damaged by a weapon card, 2 additional enemies also attempt to counterattack.

Evasive (Boss and Minions): These enemies suffer half damage, rounding up, unless both delvers are adjacent to it.
pages.q4_w1_end:
As you continue your trek through the Mistwood, Dahlia stops abruptly and motions silently at a clearing ahead. A troop of primates are poised in the circle, their many tails moving in all directions as if sensing something in the air. At the center of their circle, a larger primate sits with eyes closed in a meditative pose.

"Very intelligent creatures," Dahlia informs you in a quiet voice. "No harm." You need to get past them, but perhaps you do not need to fight.
pages.q4_w1_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q4_w1_attack:
You charge into the clearing. You easily cut them down as Dahlia gives you a dark look.

Both delvers gain 4 elements of their choice.
pages.q4_w1_pass:
These Senselle are said to be able to read minds and thus know imminent danger. Dahlia stands and the petals on her head begin to shine with a beautiful blue light. She calmly walks into the clearing. All the Senselles' tails dart towards her, but the creatures don't move a muscle.

Dahlia glides around the circle and reaches the other side, nodding quickly for you to follow. With slow, deliberate movements you edge around the creatures, arms up to show you mean no harm. At last you make it to the other side as 15 pairs of eyes continue to stare at you through the foliage.

Both delvers heal 3 HP.
pages.q4_w1_retreat:
"Hurt." Dahlia examines your injuries with concern. "Not safe now. Return again." You want to protest that you can continue, but think better of it. You vow to try another day.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q4_w2_end: The last of the Squiddies slips back into the mist.
pages.q4_w2_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q4_tidekin:
The Mistwood grows denser, taller trees obscuring the light of the sun. Dahlia's petals glow ever brighter in the dimness. Ahead, the Tide has transformed the vegetation, warping the trees so their branches swirl and bend in all directions - nature through the lens of someone's dream.

Then, movement. Figures melt out of the trees into the clearing. Tidekin, dozens of them. Some bear petals like Dahlia; others sport gemlike protrusions that make the earth quake as they step toward you. Dahlia steps forward and they all turn towards her without a word, communicating silently.

The oldest-looking Tidekin, with branch-like hands, points at you. Dahlia shakes her head. "Afraid," she says with sadness. "Blame humans for trouble."

Suddenly several Tidekin make a strange, guttural noise. From behind you, a hulking form emerges. It looks like a Tidekin, but it bears one giant claw and serrated teeth in its gnashing mouth. The Tidekin have already disappeared into the woods. You're left alone to deal with the creature.

Delvers gain 2 elements (your choice). New goal: slay the Ruined Tidekin.
pages.q4_w2_retreat:
"You hurt." Dahlia examines your injuries with concern. She looks around for her kin, but they are gone. "No help now. We return."

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q4_salvio:
As you strike the killing blow against the mutated creature, the remaining Exanimates stop, as if they were electronics whose power had been cut.

Dahlia examines the body. There are tears in her eyes. "Salvio," she murmurs. "Kind friend. Brave helper, missing many moons." His tracks, she explains, led directly towards the shores of Bird's Nest.

She motions to Salvio's wrist, where the scales have been stripped away - he had been restrained and struggled against his shackles. His chest is dotted with small punctures, like those made by the point of a needle. "Someone hurt Salvio, change him. Why? Why?" She looks at you for answers, but you have none.

Your Quest is complete! Delvers gain a Level 3 Boss part, Key Item #14 and Dahlia's favour.

A moment later, the Exanimates spring back to life. Return to combat.
pages.q4_w3_end: With Salvio laid to rest and the threat stopped, Dahlia suggests you head back to town for now and try again with her kin another day. You agree.
pages.q4_w3_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
